     JASON A. HOWTON'S AMENDED PROTECTIVE ORDER CERTIFICATION



        Jason A. Howton, pro se Individual Intervenor, files this Amended Protective Order
Certification and respectfully requests that all parties take notice.
       On May 6, 2026, Mr. Howton filed a Protective Order Certification as Item No. 3690 in
this docket, executing the signature block for Protected Materials under the Protective Order
adopted in SOAH Order No. 1. At the time of that filing, the signature block for Highly Sensitive
Protected Materials (HSPM) was inadvertently left unsigned.
        This Amended Protective Order Certification supersedes Item No. 3690 in its entirety. Both
the Protected Materials signature block and the Highly Sensitive Protected Materials signature
block are executed herein. The amended certification is necessary to ensure Mr. Howton has access
to all materials designated under the Protective Order that are relevant to his participation in this
 proceeding, including any HSPM and Critical Energy Infrastructure Information (CEII) materials
pertaining to Links F20 and F23 of the proposed route.
        Mr. Howton acknowledges that this filing is made after the June 3, 2026 deadline
established in SOAH Order No. 6, Section III.C, for submission of the list of persons who have
signed the Protective Order. Good cause exists for the brief delay: the omission of the HSPM
signature block in Item No. 3690 was an inadvertent oversight made under the constraints of pro
se participation and concurrent prehearing obligations, including preparation and filing of direct
testimony and seventeen exhibits. Mr. Howton respectfully requests that this Amended
Certification be accepted and that his name be included on the Protective Order signatory list
maintained by Applicants.
       The executed Attachment A — Protective Order Certification is attached to this filing.
Dated: June 6, 2026

Respectfully submitted,



Jason A. Howton
Pro Se Individual Intervenor
12808 FM 2843
Salado, Texas 76571
Telephone: 512-731-8731
Email: jahowt@yahoo.com
